aux_py_windows_workaround: Aux.py could not be placed in the repo, opened, or imported by native Windows tools (kernel32/CRT reserved DOS device name AUX, blocks even with .py extension and \\?\ prefix). Git-Bash/MSYS cp/diff/sha256sum CAN handle it (different underlying file API), which is how a byte-identical Aux.py landed in search/thirdparty/PackageGT/ at all. gt_thirdparty_bootstrap.py works around the import failure by exec-ing a byte-identical sibling copy (AuxSafe.py) into sys.modules["Aux"] BEFORE PaB.py/NotUsed.py are loaded via importlib -- so PaB.py, NotUsed.py and Aux.py are all left 100 percent unedited (byte-for-byte identical to the zip); only our own bootstrap script performs the workaround.
